people.imagined: A high mountain path at the place where it ends in rock and sky. The abbot has simply sat down there, as if waiting for the clouds, a small clay censer beside him. He is not tired. He has arrived.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a bare rock at a path's end high on a mountain, hands in his lap, watching the clouds rise below. Face: a very old, thin, serene face with a high domed forehead, deep cheek hollows, long white eyebrows, closed-looking half-lidded dark eyes, a faint smile, a long thin white beard; skin like old parchment; about eighty-five. Hair: white and sparse, a small plain topknot tied with a hemp string. Body: very thin, small-framed, upright and still, shoulders slack. Clothing: a robe of grey hemp of good close weave, clean, cross-collared, long sleeves, a rope belt, a square patch of cypress-bark cloth at each knee, a little bleached from sitting on rock. Hands and objects: both hands resting open in his lap; beside him on the rock a small plain clay censer with a thin thread of smoke; a seal with a hollow base lying by his knee. Background: a sea of white cloud below, a tall pale sky, a sharp edge of rock, blurred. Light: soft silver light from the upper left, clouds glowing. Expression: complete stillness, a little amused. A faint pale ochre Earth and green hint in the censer smoke. Palette: grey hemp, cloud white, silver.

people.imagined: The doorway of the empty hall, in lamplight, the night before the yearly reading. She has rung the little bell once and is waiting with her cracked hands folded, eyes wide and sharp, her voice not yet used.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the dark door of a hall in lamplight, a plum-sized bell raised in one hand just after it was rung, eyes wide. Face: a small, sharp, alert face with high cheeks, dark sharp eyes that miss nothing, straight narrow brows, a small pointed nose, a thin mouth slightly parted as if about to speak; about forty. Hair: black, tied in a short plain knot, a few strands loose. Body: small, slight, upright, a taut stillness. Clothing: a plain grey hemp robe of fine close weave with a clean white collar, and sewn all over the outer robe a scatter of tiny mica flakes that glitter like frost in the lamplight; a rope belt. Hands and objects: both hands cracked and rough with old mica-mining cuts, plainly visible; in the right a tiny bronze bell no bigger than a plum; at her side a lit oil lamp. A thin curl of lamp smoke rises beside her face, her breath shows faintly in the cold air, and the mica flakes on her sleeves throw tiny points of light across the doorframe. Background: the dark mouth of a stone hall, dusk, blurred. Light: a lamp from the lower left, glints of mica on her sleeves. Expression: concentrated, waiting, intent. A faint silver-white Metal sparkle on the mica. Palette: grey, mica silver, lamp amber.

people.imagined: A schoolroom on a cold morning, novices in rows. He holds a long stick as a pointer on a slate, tapping letters, and never once raises it against anyone. He is stern; he is thinking about the reading.
people.subject: The moment: in a schoolroom he stands with a long thin stick held as a pointer against a slate, looking sternly down at pupils out of frame. Face: a square, grey, stern face with a jutting jaw, deep-set grey eyes, thick grey brows, a flat nose, a firm mouth that does not smile, grey stubble; about fifty-eight. Hair: iron grey, cropped close, bareheaded. The cropped hair stands up in a stiff grey brush. Body: square, thick-shouldered, solid, upright, forearms thick like a jade-cutter's. Clothing: a robe of grey hemp of close weave, neat, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a square patch at each knee, a rope belt, a plain jade ring on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: a long thin bamboo stick held in the right hand, the tip resting on a slate whose chalk marks are only meaningless short strokes; thick forearms scarred with small white jade-cutting nicks. Background: a plain stone classroom with a high window and a hint of rows of small heads, blurred. Light: cold daylight from a high window at the upper left. The high window throws a pale square on the slate and on his forearm scars. Expression: stern, just, immovable. A faint ochre Earth and pale metal hint. Palette: grey, slate black, pale jade.

people.imagined: In the seal room, she lifts a stone to the lamp and looks through it before saying a word to the person who brought it. A disc of clear mica in a hidden pouch at her belt is the thing she is guarding.
people.subject: The moment: she holds a small stone up to the lamp and squints through it, eyes narrowed, before turning to the person who brought it. Face: a pale, long, still face with fine bones, large grey eyes, thin level brows, a thin straight nose, thin closed lips; about forty-five. Hair: black, with a white streak at the front, in a severe low coil with a bone pin. The white streak at the front is a single clean stripe from the part to the knot. Body: slim, erect, tight and reserved. Clothing: a robe of fine grey hemp with a white inner collar, narrow sleeves, a rope belt; at her belt a small plain cloth pouch tied shut; neat as a shut box. Hands and objects: a rough pebble held up between thumb and forefinger toward the lamp, its edge glowing; on a stone table a round disc of clear mica like a window pane, reflecting the flame. Background: a dark small room with a shelf of stone tablets, blurred. Light: a single lamp from the upper right, lighting her chin and the stone. A bright glint from the stone cuts across her eye like a tiny star. Expression: guarded, patient, a little greedy. A faint ochre Earth and silver Metal shimmer in the mica. Palette: grey, lamp gold, mica clear.

people.imagined: The slope of a lower path in the morning. He walks the novices slowly up it, a white pebble turning in his palm, quiet and broad, thinking of one he turned away and one he might not.
people.subject: The moment: walking slowly uphill on a stony path, a white pebble turning between his fingers, looking over his shoulder at followers out of frame. Face: a broad, calm, quiet face with a wide forehead, gentle small dark eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a closed forgiving mouth, a dusting of white at the temples; about forty-five. Hair: black going grey, cropped short, a little lime-dusted. Body: broad, heavy, patient, easy stride. He climbs with a slow, rolling gait, shoulders broad and slightly rounded, the weight of the body carried low. Clothing: a clean robe of grey hemp with white lime dust at the hem and cuffs, a square patch at each knee, a rope belt; sandals. The grey hemp robe is kilted up at the right side with a cord for walking, and the hem is whitened with lime; his sandals are tied with strips of undyed cloth. Hands and objects: a small white pebble held between the right finger and thumb, turning; a long plain walking stick in the other hand. On the left wrist is a loop of plain cord with a single small white bead. Background: a pale stony path up a mountain, thin cypress trees, mist, blurred. The path is of loose pale stones lined with young cypresses, a few small figures in grey climb behind him in a line, and the mist hangs thin over a hollow. Light: cool pearly morning light from the upper left. Pearly light makes the pebble glow like a small moon in his hand. Expression: quiet, kind, forgiving. A faint ochre Earth hint on the stone. Palette: lime white, grey, pale green.

people.imagined: The school in Bách Diệp Trấn. She taps the desk twice with her chalk-white fingers before she speaks, as she always does, and picks out one child out of many with a smile.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a desk she taps it twice with her knuckles before speaking, smiling at one child out of frame. Face: a pleasant, round, friendly face with bright hazel eyes, arched brows, a small nose, a warm mouth with a pencil-line of authority at its corners; about forty-five. Hair: brown with a little grey, in a neat bun with a wooden stick. Body: sturdy, middle height, brisk, upright. She stands with her weight forward on the balls of her feet and her shoulders squared, a teacher's ready posture. Clothing: a clean grey hemp robe with a pale-blue collar; the cuffs of both sleeves white with chalk dust, plainly visible; a rope belt; knee-guards of cloth at the knees. The collar is of pale blue cotton stitched with tiny white stitches, the sash is a plain grey cord knotted once, and the knee-guards are of cypress-bark cloth in a darker grey. Hands and objects: the right hand rapping the desk, fingers chalk-white; the left holding a round bronze mirror the size of a palm; on the desk a slate and chalk. A stick of chalk is held between the right thumb and forefinger, and a small slate hangs on a cord at her waist. Background: Rows of small wooden desks with children's heads bent over slates, blurred, and a broad window with the dark green of cypress trees. Light: soft window light from the upper left. Chalk dust floats in the beam of light. Expression: warm, brisk, arbitrary favour in the smile. A faint blue Water hint. Palette: grey, chalk white, soft green.

people.imagined: The Peak of Sitting Alone on a still night. He sits with a qin on his knees and his thumbnail plucks one string; a long yellow nail. He is not playing for anyone. His eyes look through the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated alone on a peak at night, a qin on his knees, a single long yellow thumbnail poised on a string, eyes looking right through the viewer. Face (most important: eyes looking through you): a lean, ascetic face with a long straight nose, sunken cheeks, large pale unblinking eyes with a far-off gaze, thin white brows, thin lips closed, a wisp of white beard; about sixty. Hair: grey-white, long, tied up in a simple topknot with a wooden pin. A few loose white hairs float in the moonlit air round his head. Body: lean, upright, cross-legged and utterly still. Clothing: a robe of grey hemp, clean, with a high collar, long sleeves, a rope belt, squared knee-guards at the knees. Hands and objects: a long plain qin of dark wood laid across his knees with a single visible string; the right thumb has a very long yellow nail, clearly visible, poised at the string. Background: a high bare rock peak, stars, a thin cloud, blurred. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left, silver on the strings. A thin rim of silver lies along his nose and the edge of the qin. Expression: remote, calm, unattached. A faint pale silver-ochre sound-shimmer around the string. Palette: moon silver, grey, dark wood.

people.imagined: A guest cell at night. He is stuffing a sweet in his cheek with a forged certificate of calm in his hand, a merchant's son who has not been made calm, scribbling a letter to his cousin.
people.subject: The moment: sitting cross-legged on a mat with a stuffed cheek and a quill, sly and sticky, scribbling a hasty letter. Face (most important: round cheeks sticky with sweets): a round, soft, pink face with very full cheeks shiny with sugar, a button nose, small bright greedy eyes, a petulant little mouth with a crumb at the corner; about eighteen. Hair: black, oiled, in a tidy topknot with a jade bead. A few strands have come loose from the oiled knot and cling to his sweaty forehead. Body: plump, soft, a little tight in the clothes. He sits with legs crossed badly, one foot tucked under his knee, leaning on one elbow with his round belly pushed forward. Clothing: a tailor-made robe of grey hemp-silk cut far finer than the abbey's, let out at the waist with a visible different-coloured gusset, a rope belt; a jade pendant at the neck. The jade pendant at his neck is carved in the shape of a small fish, and the sleeves are lined in blue silk that shows when the cuffs fall back. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand over a half-written sheet of paper marked only with short lines; the left holding a pastry; sweet wrappers scattered about. Background: a bare cell with a mat and a lamp, blurred. A narrow bunk with a folded blanket, a shelf with three jars of sweets, and a small window showing a patch of dark mountain. Light: lamp light from the upper left. The lamp throws his large shadow wavering across the wall. Expression: impatient, sly, spoiled. A faint blue Water hint. Palette: grey, sugar white, jade.

people.imagined: Running through the market of Lam Yên Thị, a pocket of red leaves rustling, to sell bookmarks to keep the abbey in lamp oil. A bandaged toe shows under one sandal.
people.subject: The moment: running through a market with a skirt pocket full of bright red leaves rustling and a few held up in one hand, laughing. Face: a round, honest, freckled face with large clear brown eyes, a snub nose, thick brows, a wide laughing mouth; about twenty-two. Hair: dark brown in two braids tied with grey hemp string, a red leaf in her hair. Body: strong, sturdy, light-footed, a runner's motion. She runs with her elbows out and her head thrown back, one foot just leaving the ground, her whole body in motion. Clothing: a clean grey hemp robe with a side-pocket stuffed with red leaves, kilted up above the ankle, a rope belt; sandals, a toe wrapped in white cloth. The robe is kilted up at the hem with a cord and the pocket bulges with leaves; the sash is a thin cord with a red leaf stitched on each end. Hands and objects: in the right hand a fan of bright red maple-shaped leaves held up like a hand of cards; her pocket full of more red leaves, spilling a few. The white cloth round her toe has come loose and trails behind her like a flag. Background: a blurred market with awnings and a crowd, a hint of autumn trees. A crowded market with striped awnings, a seller of hot dumplings, a donkey with baskets, and tall maples in red and gold behind the roofs. Light: warm bright afternoon light from the upper left. Warm afternoon sun makes the red leaves glow like stained glass. Expression: cheerful, honest, content. A faint pale blue Water hint. Palette: grey, vivid leaf red, tan.

people.imagined: The bottom of a thin mica vein, lamp in hand, wary and certain he has found a new seam. His lamp gutters, as it always does, and he looks at the rope above with suspicion.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in a narrow tunnel with a lamp held up, looking suspiciously at a long rope hanging above him. Face (most important: mica glitter in his lashes): a gaunt, stubborn, dusty face with deep-set dark eyes whose lashes glitter with silvery flakes of mica, heavy brows drawn together, a hooked nose, a mouth set in a paranoid line; about thirty. Hair: black, cropped, glittering with dust. The hair is cut short with a knife, in uneven tufts. Body: wiry, hunched under the low roof, strong shoulders. Clothing: a clean grey hemp tunic with sleeves rolled up, a rope belt, a cloth over the lower face pulled down at the neck; dust at the hem. Hands and objects: a small oil lamp in the left hand whose flame is guttering low; a short pick in the right; a thin pale seam of glinting mica in the rock beside him; a long rope hanging from above. Background: a dark low tunnel, glints of mica in the walls, blurred. Light: the guttering lamp from the lower left, glints of mica. A glittering fleck of mica on his cheekbone catches the lamp like a star. Expression: wary, stubborn, certain. A faint silver-white Metal glitter. Palette: grey, mica silver, amber.

people.imagined: The abbey kitchen at dawn. He lifts the lid off a huge millet pot and steam rises over his burned forearm, a ladder of pale scar marks, and he tastes it with a small frown; something is wrong with the salt.
people.subject: The moment: at a huge pot, lifting the lid so steam rises, tasting from a spoon with a small frown. Face: a broad, gentle, round face with soft brown eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a wide mouth puzzled; flushed by steam; about fifty. Hair: grey-black, shaved short, covered by a clean white kitchen cloth knotted at the front. Body: stocky, wide, apron-covered, a cook's solid stance. His wide back is bent over the pot and his elbows are out, a heavy patient figure, the neck thick. Clothing: a clean grey hemp tunic under a stained white apron, sleeves rolled above the elbow, a rope belt. The white kitchen cloth round his head is knotted at the front and a smaller cloth is tucked into the belt; the apron is stained with millet and has a patch of grey hemp at the pocket. Hands and objects: the cook's forearm burn-scarred in a clear ladder of pale marks, one above the other, plainly visible; in the right hand a wooden spoon; in the left a pot lid; a sack of salt beside him. On the table a row of wooden bowls and a sack of salt with a long ladle laid across it. Background: a stone kitchen with a hearth and hanging ladles, steam, blurred. Great black pots on a long brick hearth, hanging dried peppers, a stack of firewood, and a small window with grey dawn showing. Light: warm firelight from the lower left and steam glow. Steam fills the upper half of the frame in a soft white cloud. Expression: puzzled, patient, loyal. A faint gold Metal hint in the salt and a pale green hint. Palette: grey, steam white, hearth orange.

people.imagined: The first long walk up the mountain. She has guessed where the Reader goes once a year, and her scabbed knees and short hacked braid show how fast she climbs, grinning, a small bell in her hand.
people.subject: The moment: halfway up a mountain path she looks back over her shoulder, grinning, one hand holding a small bell. Face: a thin, brown, wild, freckled face with big black eyes, strong brows, a wide cheeky mouth with a gap in the teeth, a scratch on the chin; about sixteen. Hair: black, with a braid hacked off short with a kitchen knife, the ends uneven. The short hacked braid is tied with a bit of red thread, and loose hairs stick to her damp forehead. Body: small, tough, scrabbling, a quick climber. She is on one knee on the steep path with her free hand grasping a rock, her back arched and her face turned over her shoulder. Clothing: a clean grey hemp tunic, a rope belt, short trousers above the knee; sandals. The sandals are worn, the tunic has a tear at the shoulder sewn with large stitches, and the rope belt carries a clay water-flask. Hands and objects: knees permanently scabbed in plain view; the right hand holding a small bronze bell on a cord; the left grabs a rock. Background: The path drops steeply behind her through scree and thin pines, with the grey bulk of a mountain half hidden in mist above. Light: Cold bright morning light lights her scraped knees and the rim of the bell, from the upper left. Expression: brave, restless, cheeky. A faint ochre-silver hint. Palette: grey, rock brown, mist white.

people.imagined: The year she wrote down the novices' walk, on a sunlit path with the town among the clouds behind her. She is tall, nose sunburnt, braid grey as cloud, and she looks back down at someone she is teaching to climb.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A tall woman on a mountain path looks down at someone below with encouragement, a hand out. Face: a long, kind, resolute face with a sunburnt nose peeling, wide-set brown eyes, strong brows, a generous mouth smiling; about fifty-five. Hair: a long braid the grey of cloud over one shoulder. A few grey strands blow loose across her cheek. Body: tall, rangy, a walker's long stride. She leans forward from the waist with a long stride, one hand stretched out and the other gripping the staff. Clothing: a robe of grey hemp, neat, sleeves rolled, a square patch at each knee, a rope belt; a cloth satchel across the chest. The cloth satchel is stitched with a pattern of tiny clouds, the grey hemp robe is kilted at the hip, and the sandals are bound with long straps. Hands and objects: the right hand held out palm-up in welcome; the left holding a roll of unmarked paper strips; a long walking staff. Background: The path below zigzags through drifts of cloud, tiny roofs of a town show among the mist, and the sky above is a pale silvery white. Light: soft silvery light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. The silver light is soft and the colours are faded to cream and brown. Expression: encouraging, brave, patient. A faint ochre Earth hint. Palette: faded grey, cloud white, sunburn pink.

people.imagined: His last years as a guest, teaching a young woodcutter's son the abbey rule by a fire, a dry gourd in his lap, bent and gentle, remembering a spring that dried up.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A bent old man sits by a small fire holding a dry gourd, speaking gently. Face: a very old, deeply lined face, thin and kind, with a hooked nose, sunken eyes shining, a long white wispy beard, bushy white brows, a toothless smile; about eighty-five. Hair: a few white wisps under a grey cloth cap. The wispy hair curls over the ears in thin tufts. Body: bent nearly double, small and frail, shoulders curved. He sits very bent with his shoulders drawn up and his knees close, small and frail inside the layers. Clothing: a long robe of old grey hemp, soft with wear, with neat contrasting squares sewn at the knees and elbows, a rope belt, a woollen shawl; clean and soft with wear. The sewn squares on the robe are of three different greys, each stitched with a small neat stitch, and a rope belt is tied twice round the waist; a woollen shawl is draped over the knees. Hands and objects: both hands holding a dry, pale, empty gourd on his lap, cracked; a stick for walking beside. Background: A rough stone hearth, a small iron pot, a low wooden stool with a young man's shape sitting at the edge of the firelight, and a dark window. Light: firelight from the lower left, the whole picture aged and softened. The fire throws a soft moving orange on his face and leaves the corners dark. Expression: gentle, devout, wistful. A faint dry ochre Earth hint. Palette: faded grey, fire amber, gourd tan.

people.imagined: The oil store, dusk. She lifts a jar to her nose and sniffs it before signing, eyes narrowed, thinking of who will buy the spare jar this month and what she'll say to the Reader.
people.subject: The moment: in a store room she lifts a ceramic jar to her nose and sniffs, eyes narrowed in suspicion. Face (most important: oil-dark fingertips): a lean, sharp, tidy face with narrow clever eyes, thin arched brows, a long nose, a thin pragmatic mouth; about forty-five. Hair: black with grey, in a tight bun with a wooden pin. Body: narrow, brisk, upright. She stands with her shoulders slightly raised and her head tipped to one side in a careful assessing pose. Clothing: a clean grey hemp robe with a high collar, sleeves tied up with cord, a rope belt, a small brown apron; neat. The collar is fastened by two small knots of cord, the brown apron has a ladle hung from it, and the sleeves are tied with oily cloths. Hands and objects: fingertips stained dark brown with lamp oil, clearly visible against the jar; a small clay lamp with a tiny flame on the shelf; rows of stoppered jars behind. A small paper tag is tied round the neck of each jar, marked with a single dot, and a ledger lies open on a barrel. Background: a dim store with stone shelves of oil jars, blurred. Stone shelves hold rows of jars in three sizes, a pile of wicks, a funnel on a hook, and a heavy wooden door ajar to the dusk. Light: lamp light from the upper left, orange on jars. The lamp light makes the jars glow amber and the corners dark. Expression: sharp, pragmatic, calculating. A faint green Wood hint at the oil. Palette: grey, oil amber, brown.

people.imagined: On a cold autumn morning at the school gate, he leads one still child by the hand up the road. His ears are red with cold and his grey stubble untouched since the last feast day.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate on a cold morning, he holds a child's hand out of frame, ears red with cold. Face: a long, patient, hollow-cheeked face with a high forehead, pale watchful grey eyes, bushy grey brows, a thin mouth in a small smile that does not reach his eyes, grey stubble; ears very red; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, thin, cut short. A few grey stubble-like hairs show at the temples under the cap. Body: tall, narrow-shouldered, a little bent. He stands very straight with his shoulders drawn back and his free arm hanging, in the stiff posture of a man used to leading children. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, neat, with a woollen scarf at the neck, a rope belt, kneepads of dark cloth; a small bronze seal hung at the belt. The woollen scarf is dark grey and wound twice round the neck, the robe has a double row of stitching at the hem, and the small bronze seal at the belt hangs on a red cord. Hands and objects: the left hand holding out a child's small hand; the right holds a walking stick; his red ears in clear view. Background: A wooden school gate with a thin coat of frost, a path lined with dark cypresses, and a row of small figures in grey waiting in the cold. Light: The cold light turns breath to white smoke in front of his mouth, from the upper left. Expression: patient, friendly, cold underneath. A faint pale blue Water hint in the breath. Palette: grey, frost white, red ears.

people.imagined: A stone courtyard, morning. She bends to apologise to the floor after stumbling, her lime-white knuckles on the flagstone, then straightens, afraid she is in the way.
people.subject: The moment: half bowing in a courtyard, apologising to the floor with a flush. Face: a small, round, shy, tired face with downcast brown eyes, thick soft brows, a small nose, a trembling mouth; about twenty. Hair: dark brown, in one braid tied with grey cloth, tucked behind the shoulder. A stray lock sticks to her cheek and she pushes it back with the back of a wrist. Body: small, stocky, rounded shoulders, hands pressed together. Her head is lowered, her shoulders are rounded, and her hands are pressed tight, as if she wished to take up less space. Clothing: a clean grey hemp robe with a dark cloth kneepad, sleeves a bit long, a rope belt; sandals. The robe is a size too large and the sleeves hang over the knuckles; the patch at the knee is in a lighter grey, and a thin rope belt is tied in a double knot. Hands and objects: knuckles white with lime dust, in clear view as she presses her hands together; a folded note of paper in her sleeve edge. Background: Flagstones swept clean, a low wall with moss, a lone cypress, and a doorway with a shadow of someone passing. Light: The gentle morning light shows the lime-white of her knuckles, from the upper left. Expression: apologetic, humble, patient. A faint ochre Earth hint. Palette: grey, lime white, brown.

people.imagined: On the steep ridge path, reading a letter she should not read, her satchel smelling of salt and a red scarf blowing too long, a pinch of salt in her fist.
people.subject: The moment: walking up a steep path, reading a letter held at arm's length while her red scarf flies, with a sly grin. Face: a thin, brown, quick face with bright greedy black eyes, thin brows, a pointed little nose, a mischievous grin; about seventeen. Hair: black, in a short braid with a loose lock. Body: small, wiry, quick, light-footed. She climbs with a sideways skip, shoulders loose and elbows swinging, long scarf trailing behind in the wind. Clothing: a clean grey hemp tunic with short sleeves, belted with a rope; a very long bright red scarf wrapped twice round the neck and flying behind. The tunic is belted with a cord and the satchel has a strap of faded blue; her sandals are open at the toe, and the scarf is a bright, almost raw red, unhemmed at the ends. Hands and objects: a folded letter held open in the right hand, the paper bare of marks; a small cloth satchel of salt hanging at her side with a few white grains spilling; a pinch of salt in her left fist. A second folded letter pokes from her satchel, and a little grey ash is smeared on her thumb. Background: Tall pines on both sides of the narrow path, a distant cliff with a thin waterfall, and a grey roof of the abbey far above. Light: The bright morning light lights the red of the scarf like a flame, from the upper left. Expression: sly, quick, greedy. A faint gold Metal hint in the salt. Palette: grey, bright red, salt white.

people.imagined: In the mica shed at dusk, counting the sheets one by one on a table with a slow, flat-footed walk and mica dust glittering in his eyebrows. He knows about the new seam and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a table counting thin sheets of mica one at a time, slowly, with a calm face. Face: a broad, slow, soft face with heavy-lidded brown eyes, brows full of fine silver glitter, a short nose, a mild closed mouth; about twenty-three. Hair: black, cropped, glittering. Body: heavy, flat-footed, broad-shouldered, a patient lumbering stance. He stands with his feet flat and his arms heavy, his round shoulders making a slow patient shape over the table. Clothing: a clean grey hemp tunic with sleeves rolled, an apron, a rope belt; dust at the cuffs. The apron is brown canvas stitched in blocks of different threads, with a long pocket for tally pebbles, and the sleeves of the grey tunic are rolled neatly twice. Hands and objects: a stack of fine translucent mica sheets on the table, lit; the right hand lifting one pane up to the light; a tally of small pebbles in a row. The sheets of mica lie in neat piles, each pile held down by a flat pebble, and a ledger of blank pages is open beside them. Background: a mining shed with sacks and a lamp, blurred. Sacks of sorted mica stacked to the roof of a rough shed, a lantern hanging from a beam, and a small door ajar on the dusk. Light: lamp light from the upper left, mica shining. The lamp light lights the mica pane so that it glows like a window. Expression: slow, honest, a little lazy and secretive. A faint silver Metal sparkle. Palette: grey, mica silver, lamp amber.

people.imagined: Outside the dark hall at the yearly reading, waiting until dawn with the bell rope in her hand. She wishes she could go in, her shaved head cold, a pale half-moon on her palm from the rope.
people.subject: The moment: standing at night outside a dark stone door holding the rope of a bell, looking longingly at the door. Face: a pale, calm, delicate face with a shaved smooth head, large dark eyes full of longing, fine level brows, a small mouth; about twenty-eight. Hair: none, a shaved head with a faint dark stubble. Body: slim, straight, quiet. She stands with her feet together and her back straight, one hand on the rope and the other pressed flat against her robe, her whole posture a wait. Clothing: a clean grey hemp robe with a high collar, a rope belt, a square patch at each knee; a thin grey shawl over the head. The sleeves are long and narrow with a small neat stitch at the cuff, the grey shawl falls to the shoulder in a clean fold, and the sandals are of plain straw. Hands and objects: a pale half-moon callus on the left palm where the bell rope sits, clearly visible; the right hand holding the rope's end; a small bronze bell on a bracket beside her. A small lantern with a paper shade sits at her feet, giving a faint orange glow to the hem of her robe. Background: a dark stone hall door at night, a few stars, blurred. The great stone door is carved with a plain circle, a row of cypress shadows lines the yard, and the sky holds only a few faint stars. Light: cold blue starlight from the upper left, a thin line of warm light under the door. The thin line of warm light under the door lies across the threshold like a gold thread. Expression: devout, longing, doubtful. A faint blue-silver Water hint. Palette: grey, night blue, lamp yellow.

people.imagined: The school bench, midday. She cannot sit still: fingers drumming on everything, good boots muddy to the knee, she has just come back from the water's end on her own and is bored again.
people.subject: The moment: sitting sideways on a school bench, drumming her fingers on the desk, glancing at the window. Face: a pretty, sharp, sulky face with large bright dark eyes, thin impatient brows, a small straight nose, a mouth set in a pout; about eighteen. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a silk ribbon in sea blue. A loose strand of black hair has slipped from the ponytail and clings to her neck. Body: slim, restless, fidgeting. She sits sideways with one knee up on the bench and her chin on her shoulder, a restless drumming of the fingers. Clothing: a robe of fine sea-blue merchant's silk, neat and costly, cross collar, with a good dark leather belt and good boots mud-spattered to the knee; a coin-purse at the belt. The boots are of fine dark leather with a row of small brass buttons, the silk robe has a fine stitched wave pattern at the hem, and a silk ribbon is knotted at the end of the ponytail. Hands and objects: the fingers of both hands drumming on the desk; a small hanging lamp charm at the belt; a slate with only scribbles. Background: a classroom with a window onto cypress trees, blurred. Rows of benches with children in grey bent over slates, the teacher's desk, and through the window the dark lines of cypress trees under a pale sky. Light: daylight from the upper left. The cool light makes the silk of her robe shine like water. Expression: restless, bored, stubborn. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: sea blue, mud brown, grey.
